cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: -Cílem předmětu je poskytnout studentům základní znalosti o zdrojích, způsobech a důsledcích kontaminace půd cizorodými látkami, o distribuci a vazbách těchto látek v různých typech půd. Studenti budou schopni v praxi uplatnit dovednosti ohledně nejdůležitějších postupů a technologií používaných pro dekontaminaci půd.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: -The goal is to provide students with basic knowledge about the sources of soil contamination by foreign substances, distribution, and bindings these substances in different soil types. Students will be able to apply practical skills in relation to key processes and technologies used for decontamination of soils.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Soil science section (allowance 2/1) a.Chemical and physico-chemical properties of soil, sorption capacity of soil.Soil solution, soil reaction, soil buffer. Classification of soils in the Czech Republic system, taxonomic categories of classification system, soil units, their genesis, diagnosis and properties of soil types.2.Bioremediation section (allowance 3/4) a.Sources of soil pollution, their chemical and ecotoxicological characteristics. Distribution and binding of contaminants in the soil depending on the soil type, physico-chemical and biological properties of soils.b.Biodegradation kinetics, biodegradation linked to growth of microorganisms, enzyme induction, and the lag phase.c.Risks of biodegradation, threshold concentrations of pollutants, bioavailability of pollutants, activation and detoxification of pollutants.d.Biodegradation of some important groups of pollutants, bioremediation of heavy metals, bioaccumulation, biosorption.e.Biological methods for decontamination in situ (biodegradation, bioventing) and ex situ (composting, bioreactors)
